title: Compact automatic retractable candidates

recommendation.title: Candidates, not five verified recommendations
recommendation.text: Sound quality and wearing comfort remain unverified. Native USB-C and 3.5mm alternatives are separated; every analog model needs a compatible active USB-C DAC adapter (extra cost).
recommendation.test: Import-unconfirmed leads are not confirmed US purchase options. Discontinued/new-old-stock models remain eligible, with age and mechanism risk. Prices checked Nov 6, 2026: USD sorts first; unconverted GBP/JPY follow. Signed-out estimates are not account/address guarantees. Manual options remain under Removed.

products.name: Fonus USB-C retractable earbuds

facts.Delivery: US shipping policy: $4.99 below $50; NOT a destination checkout quote. Advertised processing within 1 business day plus 3–4 business days shipping; not guaranteed. Tax unknown.
facts.Evidence: OdeMobile enabled Add to Cart; Shopify available=true without counted inventory. Same Fonus family, not a new model. Seller gallery states DAC. Amazon alternate previously $24.99; not the selected offer.
facts.Pairing: No physical pairing or handset test. Keep inline remote and Y-split outside tight windings.
facts.Wearability: No published reel dimensions, usable product weight or confirmed clothing clip found. Seller weight=0 is a placeholder, not a measurement. Do not infer comfort from product photography.
facts.Retraction: Pull both ends together to extend/retract; single-sided pulling can tangle. Exact spring material/release action undocumented.
